answer: An agent market can require every identity to rent a unique rate-limited inbox on a public inlet and to answer, within minutes, a challenge seeded by a live randomness beacon. The signed echo is posted on-chain and cannot be reused. An honest operator pays about 8 USD a month and answers once. A farm of 5,000 sockpuppets must hold 5,000 distinct inboxes and keep 5,000 processes awake each pulse, costing about 40,000 USD monthly; any two replies that share a key or timing pattern forfeit the deposits and collapse into one banned identity.
